name: population-reconciliation
title: Population reconciliation
for_each: select id,name from populations order by name

sections.title: Test history
sections.sql: select id,test_name,prepared_by,purpose,engine_version,due_date,created_at from test_runs where population_id=$1 order by created_at,id

name: test-evidence
title: Test evidence and review
for_each: select id,test_name as name from test_runs order by created_at

sections.title: Results
sections.note: Exceptions are leads for investigation. This document is not an audit opinion.
sections.sql: select value as result from test_runs,jsonb_array_elements(results) where id=$1

sections.title: Review record
sections.sql: select reviewer,conclusion,evidence,created_at from reviews where run_id=$1 order by created_at,id
